name: Mud Frog
desc: Blows bubbles that pop into darkness. Croaks backwards when rekindled.

name: Mist Snail
desc: Slow, but its trail of forgetting makes you slow too.

name: Lily Ghost
desc: A drowned lily's memory. It drifts away when you get close.

name: Twigling
desc: Pretends to be an ordinary stick until you walk past.

name: Owlcrow
desc: Turns its head all the way round. Always looking your way.

name: Moss Hound
desc: Friendly in daylight. There is no daylight.

name: Sporecap
desc: Sneezes clouds of glittering spores.

name: Thorn Sprite
desc: Tiny, prickly, giggly.

name: Stump Grumble
desc: An old stump that woke up grumpy.

name: Digling
desc: A miner who forgot why he digs. He keeps digging anyway.

name: Crystal Spider
desc: Clinks when it walks. If it goes quiet, it's above you.

name: Cart Mimic
desc: A mine cart with teeth. It follows the rails. Or pretends to.

name: Echo Bat
desc: Squeaks your own footsteps back at you.

name: Salt Golem
desc: Tough on the outside. Salty in the middle.

name: Lamp Ghost
desc: A miner's lamp still looking for its miner.

name: Porcelain Doll
desc: Only moves when you're not looking.

name: Tin Soldier
desc: Still marching in a parade that ended long ago.

name: Mirror Butler
desc: Serves tea. The tea is a trap. It is very sorry.

name: Frost Jester
desc: Tells half a joke, then freezes.

name: Ice Courtier
desc: Keeps the party going, even frozen.

name: Snow Hound
desc: Wags its frozen tail. Bites anyway.

name: Hushling
desc: No face, no sound. Just a soft grey shape.

name: Sound Eater
desc: Everything goes quiet when it's near.

name: Grey Moth
desc: Eats colour. Especially yours.

name: Faded Knight
desc: Guarded the Lantern once. Still guarding. Forgot what.

name: Hollow Choir
desc: Sings a song with no sound in it.

name: Nobody's Hat
desc: A hat with nobody under it. Rare, shy, generous.

phases.announce: The bell starts to wake the drowned!
The Bellringer tolls in a fury!
Mother Bark calls her little sticks!
She opens a shadow jar and steps inside!

name: The Great Echo

phases.announce: The cave squeaks back at you!

secret: Stand completely still for 30 s during the fight: the Echo has nothing to copy and drops an Echo of Stillness.

name: The King Who Forgot His Name

phases.announce: "Guards! Who is this? Who am I?"
The King forgets to be careful!
"Let someone else carry it for once..."
His little lantern flickers. Light it!

name: Magpie Imp
desc: A thieving imp stuffed with shinies. Catch it before it pops home!

name: Treasure Goblet
desc: Little golden goblets on legs. They run in a pack and jingle.

name: Shrine Wraith
desc: Guards a cursed shrine. Beat it for the shrine's gift.

name: Candy Bones
desc: Made of toffee and giggles. Found only in the Candy Crypt.

name: Egg Snatcher
desc: Stole a warm, wiggling egg. Get it back!

name: Lantern Moth
desc: Glows like a tiny lantern. Catch it for a wish of light.
